_comment: The answers to the case: every clue that is actually true, and the memory it can be found in.
'key' is a clue key: the template id and the picks joined by '|', exactly as the notebook builds
them. Do not guess them - select the GameDirector in MainScene, open the context menu on the
Interrogation Room Director component and choose 'List Clue Keys'. Every key the game can produce
is printed to the Console, ready to paste in here.
'memoryIndex' is 0 based and matches the memories on GameDirectorMemories: 0 is the first memory.
'note' is for whoever is writing this file and is never shown to the player.
All three answers are filed under the third memory because that is where the last piece of each
one becomes visible, which is what the 'where to go next' hint is for. The grape allergy itself is
heard in the first memory - the clue cannot be written until the player has both halves.
Everything else in the case comes off the phone. These three are the only things the player has to
notice for themselves, and each one opens exactly one suspect.

clues.note: Amara says she cannot eat grapes in the first memory, then orders grapes at 1 AM in the third. The plate was for the Baron, who is the one person not in the room. Opens the Henchman.

clues.key: hadAt|The Pianist|cuts on his hands|1 AM
clues.note: Defensive cuts from grabbing the blade when the Chief pulled the carving knife on him. Opens the Pianist.
Her husband's ring, bought off Leo in the garage by the Mayor and given to her before 1 AM. Opens the Widow.
